positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop and maintain responsive and scalable user interface components using React.js, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS.
Collaborate with UI/UX designers and backend teams to build functional and user-friendly web applications.
Integrate RESTful APIs and implement state management for efficient data handling.
Optimize applications for performance, speed, and scalability across browsers and devices.
Ensure technical feasibility of UI/UX designs and convert wireframes into high-quality code.
Write clean, reusable, and maintainable code following best practices and coding standards.
Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve issues while participating in code reviews to ensure code quality.

positions.title: Frontend Developer/UI Architecture
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained web applications using casino management system and Bonus Games for IVIEW and DM using Angular, React, TypeScript, and related front-end technologies, XML.
• Developed reusable components and services using Angular CLI, improving code maintainability and scalability.
• Implemented state management using NgRx, resulting in improved application performance and reduced bug rates by 30%.
• Involved in Developer Sessions, gathering requirements, and developing a web application using agile methodology.
• Created application using responsive web design, Angular 1, Typescript, HTML5 and Bootstrap4.
• Developed application using concepts of Single page application using Angular , Angular CLI commands.
• Created a custom tool which is requires skills of .Net, Angular 13, NGRX, Type Script Html, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js, Express.js, Bootstrap.
• Familiarity working with REST web services, web pack, and consuming XML/JSON. ​
• Uing Express Framework to set up middleware to respond to HTTP request with the help of node js.
• Used SASS, LESS, Bootstrap, and Material UI to enhance the user experience.
• Used Web service protocol and data transfer using JSON and Ajax.
• Created Typescript reusable components and services to consume Restful Api Using component-based architecture provided by Angular.
• Used Webpack to bundle Typescript and JavaScript modules.
• Proficient in building interactive and responsive user interfaces using React.js.
• Working closely with internal and external customers to make sure that the applications meet the needs of the business and SGI’s SLAs.
• Used Perforce as a Version Control system git , Svn a for code management.
• Maintained and updated unit and integration tests for both the GraphQL and lib level to validate the behavior
• Developed web applications using MongoDB, Express, React / Redux, Node JS and GraphQL.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
•	Involved in Developer Sessions, gathering requirements, and developing a web application using agile methodology.
•	Front-en uses HTML5, CSS3, Angular 13, Typescript, NgRX ., node npm, Json,Ajax, and Bootstrap to build a single page web app that communicates with the backend via REST API.
•	Created application using responsive web design, Angular 13,Typescript , HTML5 and Bootstrap4.
•	Developed application using concepts of Single page application using Angular , Angular CLI commands
•	Expertise in developing applications using Microsoft technologies such as .NET Framework 4.0/3.5/3.0/2.0, Web applications using ASP.NET, and distributed applications using WCF, XML Web Services and Messaging system.
•	Worked on the usage of JavaScript, Angular, NodeJS, Express.js, GraphQL,Bootstrap, jQuery/AJAX, JSON, HTML4/5, CSS2/3.
•	Generated interactive data visualization for reports & Maps via D3.js.
•	Resolved Cross-Browser issues for Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Internet Explorer, Safari, and Opera.
•	Involved AJAX calls for data updates in UI along with JSON data parsing.
•	Wrote SQL queries, stored procedures, modifications to existing database structure as required for the addition of new features. 
•	Experience in Implementing AWS solutions using EC2, S3, RDS, EBS, Elastic Load Balancer, Auto-scaling groups
•	Involved in back-end development such as fetching user information from MySQL database.
•	Good Experience in IDEs like visual studio code with .Net Core Mvc for back end.
•	Used GIT & PlasticSCM as a Version Control system and for code management.
•	Experience in unit testing tools such Jasmine, Junit, Protractor, and Postman for Web API.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
•Involved in Developer Sessions, gathering requirements, and developing a web application using agile methodology.
•Used the new tags from HTML5 like section, article, header, footer, canvas for animations..
•Worked on the usage of JavaScript, React, NodeJS, Bootstrap, jQuery/AJAX, JSON, HTML4/5, CSS2/3.
•Front-end uses HTML5, CSS3, React, Axios, LESS, and Bootstrap to build a single page web app that communicates with the backend via REST API.
•	Developed React pages, Axios, Web services calls, and AJAX calls for the application, working with Redux architecture using complex Object-Oriented.
•	Designed and developed a funding website based on Ember, NodeJS, React JS and NextJS, Gatsby.js, WordPress,  Babel, Webpack, NPM, and Slim Framework
•	Developing interface applications using ReactJS, Redux, Node.js, next.js, Express.js, Typescript, JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, Bootstrap, HTML5, CSS3, Less, Sass, SASS/SCSS.
•Created website using React, React-Redux, React-Router for single page app routing. Modelled with a component-centric, loosely coupled architecture approach. Used Redux for state and application data (client-side) flow and management.

•	Wrote SQL queries, stored procedures, modifications to existing database structure as required for the addition of new features.

•Worked with the QA team on daily basis to fix the reported bugs/defects and checking cross-platform compatibility.
•Used GIT as a Version Control system and for code management.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
•Involved in SDLC Requirements gathering, Analysis, Design, Development, and Testing of application using Waterfall methodology.
•Worked with Forms, Validations, Modules, Factory Services, DOM, Events, Expressions, Directives, Controllers, filters, Http Request.

•Developed front-end application and components using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, React for the login, and management module.
•Developed the Application as Single Page Application using React, React-Router.
